preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output must equal the length of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) <= 10 or (len(line) == 10 and line[5:8] == '...') for line in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must either be 10 characters or less, or if longer, must follow the format of the first 5 characters, '...', and the last 2 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '' or line == s[len(s) - i - 1:] for i, line in enumerate(stdout))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must be the lexicographically smallest string obtained by applying the algorithm to the suffixes of the string s.
